tour_blurb: F164 is Email Operations: inbound messages are read here, sorted, and walked upstairs by hand. Outbound replies leave from the same desk. A buzzing room of sorting bays, inbox consoles, and a ticker tape; every letter is checked for tone, every reply is checked for what it must not say.
lessons_learned_for_next_agent: F164 is wired in design but cold in runtime: the receiver script (tools/qsb_email_receiver.py) requires an IMAP config in floors/floor_28_security_department/vault/.env.outlook.imap (or yahoo/zoho/fastmail variants) and NONE of those files exist yet. The hqskyscraper@gmail.com account does exist and is verified signed-in via Chrome on the Galaxy (qsb_session_diary 2026-06-13 20:55Z), but Gmail OAuth has not been wired — so polling is dormant and the triage log only carries 4 seed example rows from 2026-06-11. NEVER print the mailbox password, recovery code, or any other credential into the floor_card or any visitor-facing surface; the vault path may be NAMED but its contents must stay sealed. All 34 employed workers are advisory_only=true / real_money_access=false; auto-reply mode is draft-only into qsb_email_outbound_queue.jsonl, never direct-send, until OAuth is added and Ross flips a send-gate explicitly.
